changelog:
Initial release of jf-open-pro-ptz-control skill.

- Provides comprehensive PTZ (pan-tilt-zoom) control for JFTech camera devices, including direction, zoom, focus, preset management, and patrol planning.
- Supports direction control in eight directions, optical zoom/focus, manage and jump to presets, and automated patrol between preset points.
- Offers commands for special presets (such as tracking standby and self-check return positions).
- Requires device with PTZ support, correct environment configuration, and online status.
- Includes detailed API usage, environment setup instructions, and shell command examples for skill operation.
